name: Curvy Moments
source:
It's a choice based visual novel You play as a Fashion Designer who works at a famous company while he lives in a suburban town away from his family He starts to make his own business with the help of his neighbour’s wife and he became close to his dream Will you dominate the other companies including the company you used to work for...and the surrounding women ? Or you will just sit on the street and lose everything and everyone you love,Your choices will decide…..

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/adultandi/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一部基于选择的视觉小说，你扮演一名时装设计师，在一家著名公司工作，住在远离家人的郊区小镇上。在邻居妻子的帮助下，他开始自己创业，离自己的梦想越来越近。你会主宰其他公司，包括你曾经工作过的公司……以及周围的女性吗？或者你会坐在街上，失去你所爱的一切和每个人，你的选择将决定……

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/adultandi/about]Patreon[/url]]
